chunks: It is appropriate for the mutamattiʿ performing tamattuʿ with ʿumrah leading to hajj, when he exits ihram, not to wear a shirt and to resemble those who are in ihram.

key_terms.أَحَلَّ: exited the state of ihram and became permitted
key_terms.بِالْعُمْرَةِ: by means of the ʿumrah rite
key_terms.بِالْمُحْرِمِينَ: those who are in the state of ihram
key_terms.قَمِيصًا: a shirt or sewn upper garment

ai.seo_question: What should a mutamattiʿ do after exiting ihram in the ʿumrah of tamattuʿ before hajj?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs the mutamattiʿ that after becoming halal from the ʿumrah of tamattuʿ, he should still avoid wearing a shirt and maintain resemblance to the muhrimin. The hadith reflects an etiquette and legal practice connected to the rites of hajj and preserving the pilgrim’s devotional state.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2748 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"It is appropriate for a person performing tamattu‘ ('Umrah followed by Hajj) when they exit ihram not to wear a shirt and to resemble those who are still in the state of ihram."
